label: AQA-style practice (Revision-authored, not an AQA question)

question.stem: A small UK bakery is considering sources of finance for a new delivery van. Which one of the following is an internal source of finance?

options.label: C
options.text: Trade credit from a flour supplier

options.label: D
options.text: Equity investment from a venture capital firm

option_rationale: A is incorrect because a bank loan is debt finance provided by an external lender.
B is correct because retained profit is generated within the business and is therefore internal finance.
C is incorrect because trade credit is supplier-provided finance, so it is external to the business.
D is incorrect because venture capital is equity finance provided by external investors.
